cases.positive_official_identity_finding: FSSR 2.4.11(4) expressly targets children above 24 months to 36 months, allowing different optional ingredients; the FSSAI licensing FAQ says proprietary-food licensing is not available for this 24–36 month category.

documentary_evidence_gates.question: Target age above 24 months to 36 months and correct label/product category
Complete finished recipe and cereal/legume/pulse botanical identities (not assumed)
Actual preparation and packaging/label, with legal status of the special formulated supplement
Specific current CTR IX finished-food composite/crop article, if any, including sampling basis
Analytical lot data and the current FSSR/FAQ legal pathway, independently signed

cases.forbidden_source_transfer: Do not infer infant formula identity, obligatory cereal content, or automatically apply ingredient-crop aflatoxin entries to an unknown supplement.

cases.positive_official_identity_finding: FSSR 2.3.37 requires frozen blocks or individually quick frozen fruit; freezing must reach -18°C at the thermal centre after stabilisation. Fruit species and optional ingredients can vary.

documentary_evidence_gates.question: Fruit species, plant part, exact marketed frozen product (not a generic vegetables route)
IQF/block process, any blanching, and observed -18°C thermal-centre record
List of any sweeteners, salt, milk solids, spices or preservatives and batch percentages
Exact current pesticide commodity and admissible processed-food factors; do not transfer untreated raw-fruit MRL without legal basis
Representative frozen finished lot, authorised analytical matrix and signed CTR/pesticide applicability

cases.forbidden_source_transfer: Freezing/processing is not a positive match to a raw fruit commodity or unrelated milk solid contaminant article.

cases.positive_official_identity_finding: FSSR 2.3.49 defines mature Tamarindus indica after removal of outer cover and seed; moisture <=20%, total ash (dry) <=6%, acid-insoluble ash (dry) <=1%, and remaining tamarind seed <=0.5% are identity/quality checks.

documentary_evidence_gates.question: Verified Tamarindus indica, ripe fruit and seed/outer-cover removal records
Moisture, remaining seed, total ash and acid-insoluble ash certificates under FSSR 2.3.49
Proof the sold product is seedless tamarind, not tamarind pulp concentrate, preserve or confectionery
Independent CTR arsenic fruit-pulp article and relevant pesticide commodity scope decision; no unsupported transfer
Representative final lot sampling basis and signed contaminant article applicability

cases.forbidden_source_transfer: An actual fruit input and permitted additive do not convert seedless tamarind into the named finished fruit-pulp contaminant article.

cases.positive_official_identity_finding: FSSR 2.5.2(14) defines animal casings from intestines, oesophagus or urinary bladder; permits dried or wet-salted preparation, with specified defects and hygiene controls.

documentary_evidence_gates.question: Animal species and exact edible source tissue (small/large intestine, oesophagus or bladder)
Preparation records: stripping, washing, wet-salting or drying, calibration and packaging
Traceable supplier, permitted additives and tissue-appropriate food safety controls
Pesticide/veterinary residue article decision based on exact edible tissue, not muscle-meat MRL
Laboratory method validated for casing matrix, lot results and competent legal confirmation

cases.forbidden_source_transfer: Muscle and generic edible meat veterinary residue thresholds cannot be borrowed for gut/bladder casing samples.

cases.product_name: Polyols permitted under Appendix-A of FSS(FPS&FA) Regulations,2011 excluding those already standardized
cases.positive_official_identity_finding: FoSCoS category 11.6 denotes a group of bulk-sweetener/polyol ingredients; the catalogue description does not identify the marketed chemical or single purity standard.

documentary_evidence_gates.question: Actual individual polyol (chemical, INS, CAS and supplier's grade)
Mixture or single substance; % of every polyol and carrier
Applicable authorised FSSR Appendix-A/ingredient use scope and monograph
Compare sorbitol-only or other specifically named CTR entries to proved chemical identity
CoA for applicable specific impurity/heavy-metal provisions and actual lot testing

cases.forbidden_source_transfer: A polyol category may include different compounds; nickel/lead for sorbitol cannot be presumed for unspecified polyols.

cases.positive_official_identity_finding: FoSCoS lists Sajji Khar by name, but a product-list entry is not proof of an individual purified sodium carbonate or sodium hydroxide chemical article.

documentary_evidence_gates.question: Identify actual traditional alkali raw plant/mineral and manufacturing method
Quantitative carbonate/bicarbonate/other alkali profile and batch impurities
Exact marketed food ingredient identity and any NSF approval needed for the actual material
Locate a directly applicable current FSSR/CTR named substance or food article, not analogy to NaOH
Food-grade impurity certificate, finished substance lot results and formal regulatory basis

cases.forbidden_source_transfer: Listing Sajji Khar in FoSCoS, or an applicant-specific approval entry, does not automatically make all Sajji Khar any named purity monograph or blanket approval.

cases.product_name: Additives permitted under Appendix-A of FSS (FPS&FA) Regulations, 2011 and other food safety standards regulations excluding those already standardized and additives of Nutraceutical Regulations
cases.positive_official_identity_finding: Food category 99.1 covers permitted and/or standardised additives and preparations; a category label contains no unique INS, purity monograph or contaminant threshold.

documentary_evidence_gates.question: Specific substance name with INS/CAS number and authorised function
Actual ingredient grade, formulation, concentration and carrier
Current applicable Appendix-A/FSSR use permission, product category and maximum level
Specific monograph/CTR contaminant identity and any impurity criteria of that exact substance
Supplier certificate, validated as-sold additive sample and regulatory approval

cases.forbidden_source_transfer: Do not apply a sorbitol, sulfite, colouring matter or other additive-specific purity clause to every member of category 99.1.

cases.product_name: Additives VA-VF of Nutraceutical Regulations excluding those already standardised
cases.positive_official_identity_finding: FoSCoS lists the nutraceutical additive grouping, but the exact permitted entry/chemical must be identified from the operative schedule and current amendment.

documentary_evidence_gates.question: Exact Schedule VA/VB/VC/VD/VE/VF item and full chemical name
Permitted technological function, finished use and grade
Confirm operative FSSR nutraceutical rules and any amendments for that item
Determine ingredient-specific chemical purity or CTR article, not a group default
Actual vendor CoA, traceability, method and regulatory review for the substance

cases.forbidden_source_transfer: The VA–VF umbrella is not one finished material and cannot inherit a universal chemical metal or MRL article.

cases.product_name: Permitted enzymes and their preparations excluding those already listed under Processing Aids and Nutraceutical Regulations
cases.positive_official_identity_finding: FoSCoS 99.2 is an enzymes/preparations category, excluding entries already in processing aids or nutraceuticals; it does not identify an EC enzyme or organism.

documentary_evidence_gates.question: Enzyme accepted name and EC number, microbial or animal/plant origin
Production microorganism strain and any genetically modified status as relevant
Specific enzyme formulation, stabilisers, processing aid function and use level
Identify correct food enzyme/additive/processing aid authorization and impurity limits, not a blanket enzyme MRL
Manufacturing/purification evidence and validated contaminant/toxin/lot tests

cases.forbidden_source_transfer: Do not apply identical preparation-purity or microbiological/toxin standards without knowing the enzyme and production route.

cases.product_name: Ingredients listed under Schedule IV, Schedule VI and Schedule VIII of Nutraceutical Regulations
cases.positive_official_identity_finding: FoSCoS 99.7 groups functional ingredients; a reference to Schedule IV/VI/VIII is a catalogue grouping rather than a chemical or botanical identity.

documentary_evidence_gates.question: Identify exact nutrient/botanical/probiotic/prebiotic entry and schedule
Species/strain, botanical part or CAS identity and grade
Concentration, route of manufacture and eligible final use
Find any specifically listed CTR commodity or individual monograph by exact substance and matrix
Representative lot identity, contaminant/toxin tests and legal confirmation

cases.forbidden_source_transfer: No universal crop-pesticide, heavy-metal, or impurity limit is created by grouping distinct nutraceutical ingredients.

cases.positive_official_identity_finding: FoSCoS 99.7 includes a functional-ingredient premix category; the marketed premix cannot be equated to any unspecified individual constituent.

documentary_evidence_gates.question: Signed full ingredient list, % composition and source origin for every substance
Actual premix process, carrier and concentration of potential contaminants
Confirm whether legally named cereal/pulse/nut/spice is actually present and how finished-food composite scope applies
Metal/mycotoxin/pesticide-specific finished-matrix CTR article and any allowed recipe factors
Representative finished premix analyses and signed all-ingredient scope adjudication

cases.forbidden_source_transfer: Do not automatically borrow a component's analytical limit for the finished multicomponent premix.

cases.positive_official_identity_finding: Official Ayurveda Aahara Compendium identifies Narikela Ksheerika: Cocos nucifera endosperm and milk (1 part), cooked together, not plain fluid milk.

documentary_evidence_gates.question: Exact Narikela Ksheerika recipe, Cocos nucifera endosperm and milk quantities
Process/cooking and actual sold form with all additives
Authenticity of specific Ayurveda Aahara eligibility and applicable current category
Legal CTR 'Milks' vs milk-containing composite/other article, not automatic transfer
Finished cooked recipe matrix, representative lot and signed analytical/legal review

cases.forbidden_source_transfer: Even a classical recipe with a stated milk ingredient is not automatically the CTR finished article 'Milks'.

cases.positive_official_identity_finding: Official Ayurveda Aahara Compendium lists Ksheerapaka containing buffalo milk, scented floral water/aromatic flowers, water and sugar, with cooking/reduction process.

documentary_evidence_gates.question: Recipe traceable to named Ksheerapaka: buffalo milk, aromatic flowers, water and sugar
Document actual milk/water composition, boiling/reduction and as-sold form
Food category and specific regulatory identity for this Ayurvedic composite
Specific current CTR 'Milks' source applicability versus finished multi-ingredient mixture
Correct final sample, production evidence, analytical basis and signed regulatory review

cases.forbidden_source_transfer: Buffalo milk in the recipe alone does not prove the reduced, sweetened, aromatic final recipe is a plain 'Milks' finished product.
